{"arguments": {"content": "import sys
import openpyxl

def main():
    input_path = sys.argv[1]
    output_path = sys.argv[2]

    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
    ws = wb["Sheet2"]

    # Row 3 (G3:R3) holds the month dates, rows 4-7 hold the per-month data:
    #   row 4 = Opening Balance, row 5 = Debits, row 6 = Credits, row 7 = Closing Balance
    # Fiscal Month is in D7. Use MATCH to find which month column D7 corresponds to,
    # then INDEX into the appropriate data row.
    ws["D9"] = "=INDEX($G$4:$R$4, MATCH($D$7, $G$3:$R$3, 0))"   # Opening Balance
    ws["D10"] = "=INDEX($G$5:$R$5, MATCH($D$7, $G$3:$R$3, 0))"  # Debits
    ws["D11"] = "=INDEX($G$6:$R$6, MATCH($D$7, $G$3:$R$3, 0))"  # Credits
    ws["D12"] = "=INDEX($G$7:$R$7, MATCH($D$7, $G$3:$R$3, 0))"  # Closing Balance

    wb.save(output_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()", "path": "/bench/answers/56274/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
